courses.summary: 瓦爾迪茲終端連接阿拉斯加管線與油輪，公開資料也介紹護航應變體系；本課只做物流與證據帳分析。本課依序分析管線到油輪庫存、岸船交接不確定度、終端水量邊界、天候與船期依賴、海岸設備壁厚趨勢，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Valdez links Alaska’s pipeline to tankers and documents escort/response functions; this course analyses logistics and evidence accounts only. The course analyses inventory between pipeline and tanker, ship-shore measurement uncertainty, terminal water-account boundary, dependence on weather and vessel schedule, thickness trends of coastal equipment, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
